_doc: Our own flora (tools/assets/env_trees.py builds the art; Dressing.cs and KitLook.cs read this). The default since E4h (--flora-kit draws the kit's flora and grass, to compare).
species: each one atlas and material (Leaves_Own<Species>) in godot/art/world/flora/. 'pieces' are its sizes and looks;
'packed': all its pieces in one file, <species>.gltf, told apart per vertex (COLOR.a) and drawn as one MultiMesh per cell (the
kit shader's OWN_FOLIAGE collapses the pieces an instance is not); else one file per piece, <piece>.gltf.
kind: the flora kind its merged groups take (perf flips: pine, broadleaf, dead, bush, fern). lod: where lod0 ends (and lod1,
if two), m from the camera to a cell's middle; the last LOD shown to 'end' (0: always). cell: the side of the squares its
copies are gathered in, m; shadow: whether it casts (by its file's 'shadow' node, the proxy; pieces without one cast none),
in cells twice as wide. wind: one wind for all its copies (so groups merge across); null keeps each group's own.
shader: the material's parameters (kit.gdshader's OWN_FOLIAGE uniforms); 'broadleaf': 1 for the leaf light (OWN_BROADLEAF);
'tint' and 'sat' the weathering (default 0.7,0.76,0.7 and 0.86).
own: the kit's pieces drawn as ours (a list: one per copy, by its place's hash). A zone overrides any key in
godot/data/zones/<zone>/flora_species.json (its own 'own' and 'species' entries, merged over these).

stands._doc: C03 env (judge C03: the ridge one pine copied at equal height and spacing): a copy of 'kind' with at least 'dense' others of it within 'r' m (a zone's edge wall: a tree on every cell of its 3.3 m grid; the forest inside is thinner) is kept by a clump field ('clump' m across: 'keep' its mean share kept, near all in a clump's heart, few between), its size 'scale' [lo, hi] of 'base' (the larger in a clump's heart), turned anew. Dressing.Stands; FLORA_STATS=1 prints the counts.

_doc: The one stone (look bible 07: the castle, the town's footings and the river's stones share it): tools/assets/env_rocks.py tex
paints its sheet from 'palette' (dark to light, sRGB), 'warm' and 'cool' (its patches); kit.gdshader's OWN_ROCK draws it
triplanar in world space ('tile' m a repeat), with the pieces' baked edge wear, cavity and occlusion, moss on what faces
up and toward 'moss_side' (world x, z), lichen, grime from the foot ('grime_h' m), and under the water's height + 'wet_above'
m a dark wet band ('wet_dark', 'wet_rough'; or, wet_share > 0, that share of its side up to its top, the piece's 'wet_top' m:
the stepping stones); 'shade' the colour its shade keeps, 'night_fill' its moonlit floor, 'night_tint' its albedo under the
moon (darker, warmer: blue-grey under the moon's blue). 'fractures' long open cracks per sheet, 'crack_dark' their darkness. 'shader'
here is every stone's; a species' own 'shader' overrides any key (numbers, [x, y(, z)], or '#rrggbb' colours).
E5c: 'inst_val' each copy's own value (+-), 'cool_share' of copies tinted 'cool_tint'; 'stone_mix' each pebble's own class tint
(stone_a/b/c: slate, ochre, umber; its UV) and 'stone_val' its value; 'algae' a line at the water ('algae_color', 'algae_w' m); 'amb_occl'
the ambient it takes (its shade). 'clear' (Dressing): a trunk ('trees' kinds; 'trunk' m a unit of its scale) within a stone's radius
('stones': 'r' m a unit of its scale) + 'gap' m: per kind's 'mode', the tree dropped ('tree': the boulders), the stone nudged off
it (dropped if it can't be: 'nudge') or left ('none': the cliffs, in the forest walls); a stone (or a causeway's) within 'props' m
of a prop or a solid tagged collider (a pylon, a chest, a gate) is dropped (CLEAR_STATS=1 prints what it did).
Our own grass (World/Grass.cs, shaders/grass_own.gdshader): a painted clump card (3-5 blades) per cell, facing the camera
(turned up to 'yaw' degrees off it), kept by drifts of noise (the ground's clump field between 'drift' lo and hi) and the ground's
masks. 'use': the kind a zone draws (a zone's flora_species.json may set its own 'use' or add kinds). A kind: its atlas
(tools/assets/env_trees.py tex --species grass paints every kind: 'olive' and 'cool' the blades' palettes dark to light, sRGB;
'flowers' the heads' colours, in the last 'flower_cells' of 8), 'card' [width, height] m, 'cell' the grid against the picture's
quality, 'flower_share' the share of clumps that flower, and 'shader': grass_own.gdshader's uniforms (warm/cool the tip tints
on rises/in lows, night the moonlit tint, base how dark the root against the ground).
